g.text: Computed: a regular icosahedron refined by splitting each triangle into four; level 6 has 40 962 nodes (81 920 faces mean edge 120 km) — the finest
level of GraphCast's mesh. Level-0 edges are about 7 054 km long so a few message-passing steps on the multi-mesh carry information across the globe.
